summary: The blocker is fixed. A fit fighter idling beside a hit structure dropped from 6-11 s a game (pre-lane) to 0.8-4 s, and fit-and-away while the base is hit dropped from 13-33 s to 1-11 s. Veteran and adept answer base intrusions far better, base falls are down at veteran, peel turn-on rates clear 80 %, and jungle invaders are punished. Fog honesty holds (0 hidden casts) and difficulty separation holds. Against round 1's bots (e2c) HEAD is better on almost every measure. Against the pre-lane bots it is worse on several player-visible measures: Wick falls beside defenders (adept), FRAY low-health stays, laners-in-lane, adept early shadehold takedowns and match length (adept p90 32.8 min, pre-lane 27.9). Of the seven numbered requirements, items 2, 5, 6 and 7 are not met.
